scope: Apps and Clipboard share a wide seven-column launcher frame and animate between views.

checks.command: Open the installed launcher in both editions in a disposable KDE neon Plasma 6.8.1 Wayland guest. Measure the 1028 × 526 logical pixel popup through KWin and record Ctrl+4 and Ctrl+1 switching content in place in light and dark mode.
python3 -m pytest -q -rs tests/test_launcher_presets.py::test_clipboard_launcher_integration (both native integration cases passed in an isolated test home)

coverage_limits: Rendered captures cover KDE neon on Wayland. The native X11 integration cases cover Tahoe light and Golden Gate dark.
